दिल्ली , 8 माचव, 2025 फा. सं. प् लाननंग /एमपी/0001/2024/एफ-3/.—दिल्ली जिकास प्र ाजधकरण /केंद्र सरकार का दिल्ली जिकास अजधजनयम, 1957 की धारा 11-क के अंतगवत दिल्ली मुख्य योिना-2021/िोन-‘ई’ की क्षेत्र ीय जिकास योिना में जनम्नजलजखत संिोधन करने का प्रस्ट् ताि है, जिसे िनता की िानकारी के जलए एतद्द्वारा प्र काजित दकया िाता है। प्रस्ट् ताजित संिोधन के संबंध में यदि दकसी व्य जि को कोई आपजि हो/कोई सुझाि िेना हो, तो िे अपनी आपजि/सुझाि इस सूचना के प्र कािन की जतजि से 30 (तीस) दिन की अिजध के भीतर ऑनलाइन पोर्वल citzservices.dda.org.in के माध्यम से अििा ई-मेल द्व ारा mpd2021.public@dda.org.in पर अििा आयुि एिं सजचि, डीडीए, ‘बी’ ब् लॉक , जिकास सिन, नई दिल्ली -110023 को जलजखत रू प में भेि सकते हैं। आपजि करने अििा सुझाि िेने िाले व्य जि अपना नाम, पता और र्े लीफोन /संपकव नंबर/ई- मेल आईडी भी िें, िो पठनीय हो । AUTHORITY (Master Plan Section) PUBLIC NOTICE New Delhi, the 8th March, 2025 F. No. PLG/MP/0001/2024/F-3/.—The following modification which the Delhi Development Authority / Central Government proposes to make to the Master Plan for Delhi -2021 / Zonal Development Plan of Zone ‘E’ under Section 11-A of DD Act, 1957, is hereby published for public information. Any person having any objection/suggestion with respect to the proposed modification may send the objection / suggestion via online portal citzservices.dda.org.in or via e-mail to mpd2021.public@dda.org.in or in writing to the Commissioner-cum-Secretary, DDA, ‘B’ Block, Vikas Sadan, New Delhi-110023 within a period of thirty (30) days from the date of publication of this notice. The person making the objection or suggestion should also give his / her Name, Address and Telephone/Contact Number(s) / E-mail ID which should be readable. -- 2 of 3 -- [भाग III—खण्ड 4] भारत का रािपत्र : असाधारण 3 Proposed Modification: Location Area Existing Landuse as per MPD 2021 & ZDP of Zone E Land use changed to Boundaries 1 2 3 4 5 Pocket-B, Integrated Freight Complex, Gazipur 752.51 sqm (900 sq. yds.) As per MPD-2021: Commercial (C-2: Wholesale & Warehousing) Public and Semi-Public (PS-1) North: Recreational / NH-24 South: Wholesale (Fish Market) East: Recreational / 45m ROW (Dr.Hedgewar road) West: 30m ROW Road As per ZDP of Zone E: Recreational (Community Park/ Park/Multipurpose/GR) The Text / Plan indicating the proposed modifications shall be available for inspection at the office of Deputy Director, Master Plan Section, DDA, 6th Floor, Vikas Minar, I.P. Estate, New Delhi-110002, on all working days within the period referred above. The text/plan indicating the proposed modifications is also available on the following link i.e. https://dda.gov.in/mpd-2021-public-notices-2025 and https://citzservices.dda.org.in SURENDRA KUMAR MEENA, Commissioner-cum-Secy.
